static_traits.name: Lin Yaqin
static_traits.occupation: Unemployed(currently dieting, planning to study Veterinary)
static_traits.educational_background: High school graduate(admitted to the Veterinarian program, planning to Learning to become a Veterinarian)
static_traits.social_status: relationships with friends and family affected by Self-doubt; has contactable family and friends' support, but has not yet mentioned negative beliefs to them
static_traits.medical_history: no significant physical illness; no history of psychotherapy or severe psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, good logic, highly cooperative, able to be aware of and describe own automatic thoughts and emotions

basic_info.main_problem: despite Learning to become a Veterinarian, the persistent negative belief 'I cannot truly help animals' causes significant distress and Self-doubt, affecting Learning and life.
basic_info.core_demands: hoping to cope with and challenge the negative belief of 'being unable to truly help animals',Recovering and boosting motivation to pursue becoming a Veterinarian.
growth_experiences: long-term raising and caring for three pets, accumulating considerable animal-care experience through interacting with them, which became one of the important motivation sources for her choosing the Veterinarian Learning path.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/not competent
I am too old, cannot learn new things

special_situations.event: Encountering hard-to-understand concepts while preparing for exams
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot even master current knowledge points, I will absolutely never truly help animals in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: using positive self-suggestion or distraction (watching TV, chatting with friends) to ease emotions, but not yet fundamentally correcting cognitions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: if I cannot even learn this, how can I help animals in the future?

special_situations.event: When making diet-related choices or feeling diet pressure during study
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot do both Learning and diet management well at the same time, it proves I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids study tasks; uses distraction to briefly relieve frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even manage my diet, I definitely cannot learn well, and cannot help animals either.

special_situations.event: when planning the academic path and thinking about the future Veterinarian career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: being older means poor Learning ability, new knowledge cannot be learned, efforts futile
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: using Self-doubt to lower expectations, reducing investment to avoid the blow of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too old, cannot learn new things.

special_situations.event: Faced with learning setbacks, recalls past achievements (such as being admitted to a program, completing past studies)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: current difficulties are more telling, past achievements do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: ignoring positive evidence, focusing attention on current inadequacies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: these achievements mean nothing, I am still not capable.

core_conflict.wish: longing to become competent by becoming a Veterinarian, and to truly help animals, thereby gaining self-worth and recognition
core_conflict.fear: fear of failure and incompetence being revealed, worrying about being negated, losing others' approval and self-worth
defense_goal: lowering expectations through Self-doubt and avoidance, avoiding shame and relationship damage from failure
not disclosing vulnerability to family and friends to reduce the risk of being judged and negated

object_relations.self_representation: a Learning prone to Self-doubt, worrying about incompetence and not being smart enough
object_relations.object_representation: others who may be disappointed or judge oneself (could offer support but not yet asked)

manifestations: feeling during intense Self-doubt that persisting with Learning and dieting 'seems to have no meaning'
wavering about future value and ability as a Veterinarian
outcomes: Decreased Learning motivation and impaired attention
Relationship tension with family and friends

contact_model.definition: the individual has poor self-Reflection and introspection, containing excessive self-limitation and harsh self-blame, being overly careful and cautious about contact.
manifestations: frequently evaluating oneself in sessions with 'I am not smart enough' 'I am too old'
Holds harsh standards for her own abilities, ignoring existing achievements and evidence

exception_events.target_problem: when facing Learning difficulties or exam pressure,Lin Yaqin usually catastrophically predicts the future, producing intense Self-doubt, and thus reduces Learning investment and efficiency.
exception_events.unique_outcome: previously successfully completed High school studies and was admitted to the Veterinarian program; together with long-term pet-care experience, objectively showing Learning foundations and relevant abilities, contrasting with the dominant story of 'I cannot do it'.
exception_events.reason: Clue: long-term stable experience of animal care as evidence of ability; the specific milestone of being admitted to the project provides positive feedback; a long-term interest in caring for animals raised persistence and engagement.

positive_force: Deep love for animals and long-term caregiving experience
admitted to the Veterinarian program, with objective evidence of ability
Willing to accept counseling and practice de-catastrophizing, positive motivation
Has an available social support network (relatives and friends)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mental filtering
significant Self-doubt and harsh self-blame (age-related negative labels)
Under pressure, avoids studying and relies on short-term distraction strategies
not yet actively seeking help from or disclosing to family and friends, thus reducing use of external support
situational stress from managing dieting and Learning simultaneously, amplifying helplessness

target_behavior.behavior: intense Self-doubt and Catastrophizing during Learning, accompanied by Decreased attention and Learning avoidance
antecedent: Studying for exams or encountering hard-to-understand material
Planning studies and thinking about career prospects
When feeling dieting pressure or needing to make diet-related decisions
target_behavior.core_reason: negative core beliefs about ability and prospects ('I am not competent/too old to learn') triggering catastrophizing and overgeneralization, causing failure Anticipation and emotional distress
target_behavior.function: escaping feelings of failure and anxiety (temporarily reducing discomfort), briefly maintaining self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: declining Learning efficiency and investment,Academics affected and worsened Self-doubt,Relationship tension with family and friends

target_behavior.behavior: dieting plan execution frustrated (harder to persist during Self-doubt)
antecedent: when Learning is frustrated or exam-prep Increased stress
Situations of making dietary choices and trade-offs
target_behavior.core_reason: generalizing helplessness about Learning and failure Anticipation to life management, forming the global judgment 'I cannot do it'
target_behavior.function: Relieves immediate pressure and guilt by giving up/loosening plans
target_behavior.consequence: declining dieting compliance, further Reinforcing Self-denial and helplessness
